**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Madam](../persons.html#133)
After having exhibited the mittens to various very respectful admirers and waiting in vain for my [Cousin](../persons.html#28) to come and see them last week I have decided on sending them to her registered and I am sure she will carefully return them in a short time with many many thanks for the privilege.

Yours thankfully
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed ‘Mrs Belfield/Malmain/French hay /Bristol and postmarked Winchester 12 February 1900.
